product.pageTitle: BASIC MEDIUM WEIGHT T-SHIRT /02 - White / Navy | ZARA United States

fit.brandWords: Regular fit T-shirt. Round neck and short sleeves.

material.source: product page, Composition & care: "Composition: 98% cotton, 2% elastane". Zara does not say how much it stretches.

garment.label: Product Measurements, Product dimensions (IN): "The garment is measured flat"

derivedCircumference.derivation: Zara measures the garment flat, side to side at armhole height: a width, not a circumference. Where Fynd needs the garment's chest around, it takes 2 × the published flat width and labels the result estimated: it assumes the front and back are the same width and ignores fabric give. The derived value is never stored here.

methodSource.says: How a garment is measured: "CHEST — Measure from side to side at armhole height." Product dimensions: "The garment is measured flat".

How a garment is measured: "FRONT LENGTH — Measure from the shoulder seam to the bottom hem of the garment." Recorded as from the high point of the shoulder, where the shoulder seam meets the collar; Zara does not say which point of the seam.
How a garment is measured: "SLEEVE LENGTH — Measure from the shoulder/sleeve seam to the hem of the sleeve."
How a garment is measured: "BACK WIDTH — Measure from the shoulder/sleeve seam to the other shoulder/sleeve seam."

sources.what: product page: Description, Composition & care, Product Measurements (inches) and How a garment is measured

notes: Zara publishes the finished garment's measurements only, and no body chart: Fynd can compare it with a garment that fits, or with a chest measurement plus room, but not with a body chart.
Values are as shown with the IN toggle, one decimal place.
Elastane (2%) suggests some stretch; Zara does not say how much, so stretch is left unknown.
Sold under MAN; the product's offers list S, M, L, XL and XXL only — no XS.
